mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month and < previous month - 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST signals a broad-based deterioration in demand, which reduces corporate revenue and profit forecasts, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of co-declining episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPIAUCSL above 4% coincident with a simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS above 3% signals a dual shock of inflation and tightening, which increases uncertainty and risk premia, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month moving average + 1% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for four consecutive months signals strengthening household savings and reduced consumption, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12-month moving average + 2% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
